description: Canonical registry of KYBERION_* environment variables (OP-05). Regenerate with pnpm generate:env-registry; curated fields are preserved.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2A_SECRET
entries.description: Shared secret used to sign and verify A2A envelopes; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2A_SIGNATURE
entries.description: A2A envelope signature policy: warn audits missing signatures while enforce rejects unsigned or unknown-sender messages.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2UI_BRIDGE_URL
entries.description: Optional A2UI rendering bridge endpoint used by the presence actuator; keep it on an approved local or trusted surface and do not treat it as an authorization boundary.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_BOOT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds an agent adapter waits for a newly started runtime to become ready before failing the boot request.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_ID
entries.description: Logical agent identity attached to runtime, task, and audit records; use a stable non-secret identifier.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds an inactive agent runtime may remain before lifecycle cleanup; the default is 20 minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_INFLIGHT_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum concurrent requests admitted for one agent runtime; excess work receives a bounded busy response.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RING
entries.description: Numeric policy ring supplied to operation-policy evaluation; higher rings may have stricter execution rules.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the agent runtime supervisor daemon; the default is loopback so the local control endpoint is not exposed remotely by omission.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_LOCK_PATH
entries.description: Lock-file path used to prevent duplicate agent runtime supervisor daemons; keep it in the governed runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_PORT
entries.description: TCP port for the agent runtime supervisor when transport is tcp; zero permits the operating system to select a port.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET_PATH
entries.description: Unix-domain socket path for local agent runtime supervisor RPC; keep it under the governed runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN
entries.description: Shared token for newline-JSON agent runtime supervisor RPC.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_TRANSPORT
entries.description: Transport used by the agent runtime supervisor; unix is the local default, while tcp requires an explicitly controlled host and port.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_TIER
entries.description: Execution authority tier propagated to secure-io and policy checks; child processes may downgrade but must not use it to bypass governed access.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed for one agent conversation turn before the mediator returns a timeout.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_AGENT
entries.description: Generated AGY workspace agent name selected for CLI sessions, for example kyberion-reviewer.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for agy cli bin; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_CLI_LOG_FILE
entries.description: Optional path override for agy cli log file; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the AGY CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for agy cli timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SANDBOX
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for agy sandbox; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_API_KEY
entries.description: Internal bridge transport for the Antigravity SDK API key; prefer GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY in the parent environment.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_CWD
entries.description: Working directory passed from the AGY SDK adapter to its Python bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_PYTHON
entries.description: Python 3.10+ interpreter used by the official google-antigravity SDK bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_FILE_SECRETS
entries.description: Acknowledge the plaintext file-secret fallback when the OS keychain is unavailable (warn-phase; see AC-05).

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORK
entries.description: Allow explicitly opted-in development flows to reach local or private network addresses; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_STUB_FALLBACK
entries.description: Keep the reasoning stub fallback when the configured provider chain is unavailable; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_TEST_NOTIFICATIONS
entries.description: Allow operator notification delivery during tests; test-only opt-in.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNAUTH_REMOTE
entries.description: Allow unauthenticated remote Chronos readonly access only when no API or localadmin token is configured; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_CLI
entries.description: Allow the service actuator to execute CLI commands; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_JS
entries.description: Allow code or system actuators to evaluate JavaScript; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_SHELL
entries.description: Allow shell execution by code, system, or network actuators; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTHROPIC_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Fast model override for the Anthropic API route.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTHROPIC_MODEL
entries.description: Model override for the Anthropic API route.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTHROPIC_NATIVE_DEFERRED_TOOLS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for anthropic native deferred tools; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTIGRAVITY_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for antigravity cli bin; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_API_TOKEN
entries.description: Bearer token for authenticated surface/API requests.

entries.name: KYBERION_APPLE_FM
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for apple fm; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_APPLE_FM_SAMPLE_AUDIO
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for apple fm sample audio; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_BUS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for audio bus; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_DEVICE_UID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for audio device uid; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_PERMISSION_CONFIRMED
entries.description: Operator acknowledgement that the meeting preflight microphone permission was confirmed for this session; use 1 only after the OS permission check succeeds.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_RECORD_COMMAND
entries.description: Local microphone capture command used by the voice sample recorder; it receives governed template values such as output and duration and is not a general-purpose user command entrypoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY
entries.description: HMAC key used to authenticate the append-only audit chain; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_CONTINUITY_ENFORCE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for audit continuity enforce; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional shell sink for forwarding audit events after the governed audit sink records them locally; use an explicitly approved command.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_HEADERS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for audit forwarder headers; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for audit forwarder timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_URL
entries.description: Optional HTTP destination for forwarding audit events; outbound delivery remains subject to the egress policy and local audit persistence is authoritative.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUTO_SEAL
entries.description: Automatically seal completed personal-tier missions.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUTONOMOUS_OPS_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for the autonomous-operations policy catalog; the selected catalog remains schema-validated before an operation is admitted.

entries.name: KYBERION_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
entries.description: Passphrase used to encrypt and restore backup archives; keep it in an external secret manager and never store it in the archive or registry.

entries.name: KYBERION_BEST_OF_N
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for best of n; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BEST_OF_PROVIDERS_LIVE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for best of providers live; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLACKHOLE_DEVICE_LABEL
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for blackhole device label; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLACKHOLE_INPUT_UID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for blackhole input uid; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLACKHOLE_OUTPUT_UID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for blackhole output uid; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLACKHOLE_SCRIPT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for blackhole script; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_PASSWORD
entries.description: Password used to authenticate requests to the BlueBubbles server.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_SEND_METHOD
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for bluebubbles send method; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_URL
entries.description: Base URL of the local or approved BlueBubbles bridge used for iMessage operations; it configures transport only and does not grant tenant access.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: Shared secret used to authenticate inbound BlueBubbles webhook requests.

entries.name: KYBERION_BRAND_FONT_STACK
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for brand font stack; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_BRAND_MONO_STACK
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for brand mono stack; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CHRONOS_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for chronos idle timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_AGENT_TOOLS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for claude agent tools; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Path override for the claude CLI binary.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_EXTRA_ARGS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for claude cli extra args; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Claude CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for claude cli timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias fast model override for Claude routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_MODEL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias model override for Claude routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_NATIVE_SUBAGENT
entries.description: Set to 1 to delegate through Claude's provider-native sub-agents (one shared stream-json CLI session / SDK `agents`) instead of spawning `claude -p` per task. Fails closed with subagent_unavailable when a delegation cannot be observed.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_APPROVAL
entries.description: Approval mode for the Codex app-server adapter; strict keeps the governed approval path and relaxed permits provider-side relaxed approvals.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Explicit executable path for the Codex CLI query backend; when unset, the backend resolves an acceptable Codex binary from the host.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_CLI_EXTRA_ARGS
entries.description: Whitespace-separated extra arguments appended to Codex CLI query invocations.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Codex CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a Codex CLI query; unset keeps the adapter default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_INSTANCES
entries.description: Comma-separated Codex instance identifiers used by provider-health routing to track independent quotas and demotions.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_MODE
entries.description: Codex transport mode; app-server uses the JSON-RPC adapter, while exec and legacy select the CLI adapter.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used by the Codex agent and intent compiler routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_MODEL_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider hint paired with the Codex model identifier for app-server execution.

entries.name: KYBERION_COMFY_BASE_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the ComfyUI image or video generation provider; requests must remain within the governed provider and egress boundaries.

entries.name: KYBERION_COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR
entries.description: Optional path override for comfy output dir; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_COMPUTER_SURFACE_PRINCIPAL
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for computer surface principal; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONFIDENTIAL_OPERATOR_LEARNING_DISPATCH_REGISTRY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for confidential operator learning dispatch registry path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXT_BUFFER_TOKENS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for context buffer tokens; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXT_PACK_ID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for context pack id; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXT_RESERVE_TOKENS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for context reserve tokens; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXT_WINDOW_TOKENS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for context window tokens; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXTUAL_INTENT_LEARNING_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for contextual intent learning path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_CONTEXTUAL_INTENT_MEMORY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for contextual intent memory path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_COPILOT_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for copilot cli bin; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_COPILOT_MODEL
entries.description: Model name requested from the Copilot ACP backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_ARCHIVE_HISTORY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for curation archive history path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_REPORT_PATH
entries.description: Optional output path for the knowledge curation report; use a governed shared runtime or report location rather than a tenant-unscoped data directory.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_SCAN_ROOTS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for curation scan roots; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_SLO_CONFIG_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for curation slo config path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_TAXONOMY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for curation taxonomy path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_TENANT_ROOTDIR
entries.description: Test and controlled-operation root override for tenant curation ledger discovery; it is resolved through the governed root resolver and must not be used to widen tenant scope.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURSOR_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for the Cursor Agent CLI binary (`cursor-agent`); leave unset to resolve from PATH.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURSOR_CLI_EXTRA_ARGS
entries.description: Optional whitespace-separated extra argv passed to cursor-agent headless invocations.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURSOR_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model id for the Cursor Agent CLI reasoning backend; defaults to auto (Free-plan compatible).

entries.name: KYBERION_CURSOR_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional wall-clock timeout in milliseconds for a single cursor-agent reasoning call; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_CUSTOMER
entries.description: Active customer profile slug used to resolve the profile root.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_DEPTH
entries.description: Delegation hop depth propagated to child processes for policy limits; operator-started roots default to zero.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_KILL_GRACE_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when a delegated child exceeds its wall-clock budget; the default is 5 seconds.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: Global maximum number of concurrent delegated tasks admitted by the process semaphore; the default is 4.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_NOTIFICATIONS_PATH
entries.description: Override path for durable delegation notifications; keep it inside the governed shared runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_PROVIDER_CAPS
entries.description: Optional JSON object mapping provider ids to positive concurrency caps, for example {"claude":3}; invalid JSON is ignored.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_PROVIDER_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: Default maximum concurrent delegated tasks per provider when no provider-specific cap is configured; the default is 2.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_STORE_DIR
entries.description: Directory for durable delegation task records; keep it within governed shared runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_SUMMARY_RETRY
entries.description: Enables the continuation retry when a delegated final summary is too brief; set false, 0, or off only for controlled compatibility runs.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_TRACE_PATH
entries.description: Override path for delegated-task trace records used for observability and replay; keep it in governed runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_WALL_CLOCK_MS
entries.description: Wall-clock budget per delegated task before timeout and child termination; the default is 10 minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOY_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional shell deployment adapter command for CI/CD dispatch; real deployment remains behind the deployment approval gate and explicit configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOY_CONFIG_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for deploy config path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOY_PROJECT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for deploy project; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOY_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for deploy timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOYMENT_PROJECT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for deployment project; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_DISABLE_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_DAEMON
entries.description: Disable the agent runtime supervisor daemon for controlled local or test runs.

entries.name: KYBERION_DISABLE_EMBEDDINGS
entries.description: Disable embedding generation and use the non-semantic retrieval path.

entries.name: KYBERION_DISPATCH_MAX_ROUNDS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for dispatch max rounds; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_DRAFT_REFINE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for draft refine; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_EGRESS_POLICY
entries.description: Network egress policy override; use warn to observe or enforce to reject destinations outside the governed allowlist. The policy file remains authoritative for domains.

entries.name: KYBERION_EGRESS_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path to the governed egress-policy catalog; keep it in an approved knowledge or deployment configuration location.

entries.name: KYBERION_EMAIL_FROM
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for email from; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENABLE_SERVICE_ACTUATE_TOOL
entries.description: Enable the service-actuate tool for trusted operators after capability approval.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENTITY_GOVERNANCE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for entity governance; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENTITY_GOVERNANCE_STRICT_WARNINGS
entries.description: Fail check:entity-governance when observed warnings exist.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT
entries.description: Strict startup validation of KYBERION_* variables; on by default. Set to 0/false to downgrade unregistered or mistyped variables to warnings. Register new names in env-registry.json via pnpm generate:env-registry.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT_DOCS
entries.description: Generator-only strictness: when enabled, the env-registry drift check also fails while any registry entry remains undocumented. Off by default; independent of KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT (CLI startup validation).

entries.name: KYBERION_FIRST_WIN_LIVE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for first win live; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_FLUID_AUDIO_STT_COMMAND
entries.description: Local FluidAudio/Parakeet JSON bridge command for speech-to-text; the bridge receives a governed audio path and returns structured transcription output.

entries.name: KYBERION_FLUID_AUDIO_STT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the FluidAudio/Parakeet batch STT bridge; unset uses the shell bridge default of five minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_FORMAT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for format; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_GATE_OVERRIDE_SIGNATURE
entries.description: Human-override signature policy: warn observes missing or invalid gate signatures while enforce rejects them.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for gemini cli bin; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Gemini CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_CLI_TIMEOUT
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for gemini cli timeout; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Fast model override for the Gemini route.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used by the Gemini API and routing fallback.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_TTS_VOICE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for gemini tts voice; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_URL
entries.description: Optional Gemini API base URL override; leave unset for the provider default and use only an endpoint permitted by the egress policy.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_VIDEO_API_KEY
entries.description: API key used by the explicit Google Veo video-generation backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_VIDEO_URL
entries.description: Optional base URL override for the Google Veo video-generation API.

entries.name: KYBERION_GENERATION_SCHEDULE_INTERVAL_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for generation schedule interval ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_GLOBAL_INFLIGHT_LIMIT
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for global inflight limit; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_GOAL_LOOP_MAX_ROUNDS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for goal loop max rounds; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_KEY
entries.description: xAI Grok API key for the grok-api reasoning backend. `XAI_API_KEY` is also accepted for compatibility.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_MODEL
entries.description: xAI Grok API model id. Defaults to grok-4.6 when omitted.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_URL
entries.description: Optional xAI-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://api.x.ai/v1.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Optional path override for grok cli bin; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_CLI_EXTRA_ARGS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for grok cli extra args; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Grok Build CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_CLI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for grok cli timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_HARNESS_SUBAGENT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for harness subagent; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_HINTS_ARCHIVE_DIR
entries.description: Optional path override for hints archive dir; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_HINTS_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for hints path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_HISTORY_SEARCH_DB
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for history search db; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_HOST_AGENT_ACTIVE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for host agent active; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_IMESSAGE_WAKE_WORD
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for imessage wake word; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_IN_SESSION_SUBAGENT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for in session subagent; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_INGEST_QUOTA_TEST
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for ingest quota test; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_INJECTION_SCOPE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for injection scope; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_INJECTION_SUSPECTED
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for injection suspected; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_MODEL
entries.description: Explicit model override for intent contract compilation.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_MODEL_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider hint paired with the intent compiler model override.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider route selected for intent contract compilation.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_EXPORT_DIR
entries.description: Override for exported intent-contract memory artifacts; the global default is active/shared/exports/intent-contract-memory and tenant runs remain physically scoped.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_REPORT_PATH
entries.description: Override for the intent-contract memory sync report; the global default is active/shared/runtime/reports/intent-contract-memory-sync-latest.json.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_RUNTIME_PATH
entries.description: Override for the global intent-contract memory runtime file; relative values resolve from the repository root and tenant-scoped runs use their physical scope path.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_SCHEMA_PATH
entries.description: Override for the intent-contract memory schema used by the sync command; the default is knowledge/product/schemas/intent-contract-memory.schema.json.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_CONTRACT_MEMORY_SEED_PATH
entries.description: Override for the governance seed used by intent-contract memory sync; tenant-scoped memory cannot be promoted into the global seed without the governed brokered path.

entries.name: KYBERION_KI_CACHE_DIR
entries.description: Optional path override for ki cache dir; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_KI_CACHE_MAX_MB
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for ki cache max mb; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_KILL_SWITCH_INTERVAL_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for kill switch interval ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_DELIVERY_DIR

entries.description: HMAC key used to sign and verify share-grant records.

entries.description: SMTP host that activates the email actuator SMTP mode; pair it with the separately managed SMTP credentials and keep outbound delivery within the approved egress boundary.

entries.description: SMTP password or app token used by the email actuator; provide it through the secret store and keep it out of logs and configuration artifacts.

entries.description: Optional comma-separated arguments appended to the shell streaming STT command; values are trimmed and empty items are ignored.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_CAPABILITIES
entries.description: Optional JSON object describing shell STT capabilities, such as timestamps, granularity, and local_only; invalid or unsafe shapes are ignored at the bridge boundary.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_COMMAND
entries.description: Speech-to-text bridge command override. Supports {{audio}} and {{language}} placeholders; stdout is the transcript. macOS Apple Silicon example: whisperkit-cli transcribe --audio-path {{audio}} --language {{language}} (model auto-downloads on first run).

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_COMPUTE_TYPE
entries.description: Compute type passed to faster-whisper; CPU defaults to int8 and non-CPU devices default to float16.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_DEVICE
entries.description: Device selected by the faster-whisper speech-to-text bridge, such as cpu or cuda.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_LANGUAGE
entries.description: Language hint for local Whisper speech-to-text adapters; managed streaming adapters default to ja when unset.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier or size used by faster-whisper when STT_MODEL_DIR is not set.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_MODEL_DIR
entries.description: Optional repository-safe model directory used by local STT adapter selection, including faster-whisper and Whisper model availability checks.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_OUTPUT_FORMAT
entries.description: Output format expected from the explicit shell STT command; `json` enables structured text/capabilities/segments parsing, while text keeps stdout as the transcript.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_PRIORITY
entries.description: Numeric priority assigned to the explicit shell STT bridge when multiple speech-to-text bridges are registered; higher-level selection may use this value for ordering.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for the explicit shell batch STT bridge; unset uses the bridge default of five minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_WINDOW_SEC
entries.description: Audio window length in seconds for streaming Whisper adapters; defaults are adapter-specific.

entries.name: KYBERION_STYLE_KEYS
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for style keys; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO
entries.description: Authority escalation switch consumed by the policy engine; use only for explicitly approved operations.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO_KEY
entries.description: Key used by the system prelude for privileged sudo coordination; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO_SCOPE
entries.description: Path scope restriction for KYBERION_SUDO escalation.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_ALLOWLISTS
entries.description: JSON actor allowlist keyed by surface (for example {"telegram":["actor-id"]}); an invalid configured value fails closed for the affected surface.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_QUERY_CONFIG_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for surface query config path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_QUERY_PHASE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for surface query phase; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_QUERY_ROLE
entries.description: Fallback role selector for surface-query provider resolution; a request or server-resolved context role takes precedence and this value does not grant authorization.

entries.name: KYBERION_TASK_GRANTS_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for task grants path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TASK_ID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for task id; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TASK_MODEL_ROUTING
entries.description: Task model-hint policy: advisory records routing hints without changing the manifest choice, while enforce applies a validated task model hint when present.

entries.name: KYBERION_TASK_SCENARIO_DIR
entries.description: Optional path override for task scenario dir; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TELEMETRY
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for telemetry; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TEN_VAD_PYTHON
entries.description: Optional Python executable for the TEN VAD bridge; unset uses KYBERION_PYTHON_BIN when available and otherwise python3.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT
entries.description: Active tenant slug for tenant-scoped writes and branding.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_DESIGN_ROOT
entries.description: Optional governed root for tenant design assets used by the Chronos tenant-design route; viewer-resolved tenant scope still controls which customer data is selected.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_ID
entries.description: Legacy tenant identifier fallback used by peer and surface entrypoints; prefer the canonical KYBERION_TENANT slug and server-resolved viewer scope where available.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED
entries.description: Tenant binding policy for confidential work; strict (or the boolean value 1/true where supported) rejects an unbound tenant, while warn records the migration warning.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_DISCONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for terminal disconnect timeout ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the terminal bridge; the default is loopback so terminal control is not exposed remotely by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_RESTORE_RUNTIME
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for terminal restore runtime; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_SESSION_RETENTION_MS
entries.description: Optional numeric tuning value for terminal session retention ms; leave unset to use the governed default.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_TOKEN
entries.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the terminal bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_TEST_OBSERVABILITY_DIR
entries.description: Optional path override for test observability dir; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TIER
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for tier; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TIMEZONE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for timezone; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TOOL_ACTUATOR_ROUTING_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for tool actuator routing policy path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TOOL_RUNTIME_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for tool runtime policy path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TOOL_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for tool runtime registry path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_TRUST_PROXY
entries.description: Trust x-forwarded-for and x-real-ip as the client peer for local-surface detection. Keep disabled unless a trusted reverse proxy overwrites these headers.

entries.name: KYBERION_TTS_ARGS
entries.description: Optional comma-separated arguments appended to the shell streaming TTS command; values are trimmed and empty items are ignored.

entries.name: KYBERION_TTS_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional streaming text-to-speech executable for realtime voice and meeting flows; it reads newline-delimited UTF-8 text and emits PCM audio through the governed bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_TTS_PLAY_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional PCM playback command used by the streaming TTS bridge; it overrides the platform default player and remains a local runtime configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_TUI_DISABLE_AUDIT
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for tui disable audit; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_UI_LOCALE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for ui locale; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_VAD
entries.description: VAD backend id used by the voice loop; `energy` is built in and unavailable or unknown neural backends degrade to energy with a surfaced reason.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIDEO_COMPOSITION_TEMPLATE_REGISTRY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for video composition template registry path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIDEO_RENDER_RUN_MODE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for video render run mode; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIDEO_RENDER_RUNTIME_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for video render runtime policy path; keep it inside governed repository or runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIEWER_PRINCIPAL
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for viewer principal; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIEWER_SCOPE
entries.description: Chronos viewer tenant audit mode: off, warn, or enforce. Unregistered tenant expansion is denied in every mode; warn records the attempt first. Defaults to warn.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_KEY
entries.description: API key for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_BRIDGE_PATH
entries.description: Optional path to the Python voice-learning bridge; when unset, the bundled voice-actuator bridge is used.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_ENGINE_REGISTRY_DIR
entries.description: Directory override for the split voice-engine registry files; used with the canonical registry path when present.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_ENGINE_REGISTRY_PATH
entries.description: Explicit voice-engine registry path; the selected file is validated against the voice-engine schema before use.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_HUB_TTS_CONFIG_PATH
entries.description: Override for the voice-hub text-to-speech language configuration; the default is knowledge/product/presence/voice-hub-tts.json.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_LANGUAGE
entries.description: Language hint passed to the Python voice bridge; when unset, the unified locale resolver supplies the language.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_OUTPUT_DIR
entries.description: Directory for generated Python voice artifacts; the default is active/shared/tmp/voice-out under the current repository.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_PLAY_BLACKHOLE
entries.description: Set to 1 to send Python voice output through the configured BlackHole playback bridge; it has no effect without KYBERION_BLACKHOLE_SCRIPT.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_PROFILE_ID
entries.description: Voice profile identifier forwarded to the Python/TTS bridge; the Python bridge is not installed unless this value is present.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_PROFILE_REGISTRY_DIR
entries.description: Directory override for split voice-profile registry files; canonical overlays remain enabled when no explicit registry file is selected.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_PROFILE_REGISTRY_PATH
entries.description: Explicit base voice-profile registry path; selecting it disables the automatic personal and customer overlay lookup.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_RUNTIME_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Override for the voice runtime policy catalog; the default is knowledge/product/governance/voice-runtime-policy.json and invalid input falls back conservatively.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_SAMPLE_INGESTION_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Override for the voice sample-ingestion policy catalog; the selected file is schema-validated before profile registration.

entries.name: KYBERION_VOICE_UPGRADE_ALIAS
entries.description: Compatibility alias for the voice upgrade target; cloud selects tier 1 and local selects tier 2 when no explicit CLI target is supplied.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for windows ai; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_ENDPOINT
entries.description: Foundry Local or other approved Windows local AI endpoint used by the Windows assistance bridge; keep the endpoint local or explicitly allowlisted.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier selected by the Windows local AI bridge; it is paired with KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_ENDPOINT and does not itself grant external access.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AUMID
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for windows aumid; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_IMAGE_GENERATOR
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for windows image generator; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_STT_BACKEND
entries.description: Selects the Windows speech-to-text backend, such as faster_whisper, for the local voice actuator; the selected backend must be installed and available in the governed runtime.

entries.name: KYBERION_WISDOM_LLM_PROFILE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for wisdom llm profile; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_WORK_COORDINATION_NAMESPACE
entries.description: Optional runtime setting for work coordination namespace; leave unset to use the built-in configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_WORKITEM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Maximum milliseconds a mission work item waits for one provider response before recording a blocked result.
